A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain complete, readable main texts and Appendices A–G. Their equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original fine-tuning, layer-freezing, data-ordering, and weight-grafting experiments, with additional localization and sensitivity results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the layer-freezing comparisons in Table 2, grafting results in Table 3, and additional-model experiments in Appendix G.

M1.justification: The three-component extractive framework, causal and linearized scores, upstream-score surrogate, and weight-grafting procedure remain unchanged. Replacing references to backpropagation with gradient descent in Section 6 clarifies terminology without changing the documented procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same FIRST-HOP and SECOND-HOP datasets and fictitious name–city–animal tasks for data ordering and counterfactual grafting. Section 3's revised description adds no task or dataset coverage.

E2.justification: The layer-freezing variants and baselines in Table 2 and the counterfactual-fact model and control graft in Table 3 are unchanged. The newly cited related work is not added as an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: The rank metric, 80/20 training/test fact split, training settings, freezing procedures, data orderings, and learning-rate/epoch sweeps are retained. The revised descriptions clarify existing experiments rather than introduce different protocols.

E4.justification: The layer-freezing analysis in Section 5.2, graft localization in Appendix E, and learning-rate and model sensitivity analyses in Appendices F–G are unchanged. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Five-seed reporting and averaging in Appendices F–G remain unchanged, as do Appendix E's correlation and statistical-significance statements. No new uncertainty reporting or statistical procedure is introduced.

E6.justification: The numerical tables and empirical plots, including appendix results, are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains counterfactual-implication mean ranks of 9.13 for the counterfactual-fact model, 1.13 for the grafted model, and 8.38 for the control graft.

T1.justification: Section 4's causal definitions and the linearization and perturbation derivations in Appendices A–B retain the same mathematics. The rewritten OCR description restates the existing definition without changing its substance.

C1.justification: The four stated contributions and the abstract and conclusion claims remain the same: extractive structures explain OCR, layers enable different generalization, and data ordering and weight grafting support the learning hypothesis.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning latent two-hop recall, distributed fact storage, and extractive-structure learning are retained. Both versions acknowledge possible alternative OCR mechanisms, hyperparameter sensitivity, and unresolved differences across models; wording refinements add no substantive qualification.

D1.justification: Appendices B–D retain the implementation procedures, checkpoint, optimizer settings, dataset lists, and templates. The random name–city pairing sentence added to Appendix D.1 already appeared in v1 Section 3, so it is relocated documentation.

R1.justification: v2 adds Krasheninnikov et al. (2023) to the introduction, related work, and bibliography. Section 2 explicitly acknowledges earlier theorizing about mechanisms related to extractive structures and emphasizes the present work's empirical verification, providing a limited refinement of research positioning.

P1.justification: Local rewrites tighten the abstract, OCR definition, dataset explanation, and Section 6 terminology. Dataset-construction details move from Section 3 to Appendix D.1, and acknowledgements are updated; the overall section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Caption typography, labels, and wrapping change throughout, causing nearby text to reflow. Figure 1 corrects 'speaks' to 'speak', and several captions receive wording refinements. The same figures, tables, and empirical graphics are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves attribution by acknowledging earlier related mechanism proposals in Section 2. Clearer task descriptions in Section 3 and more explicit fictitious-implication terminology in Section 6.1 also improve exposition. The experimental evidence and stated limitations remain unchanged, so the overall quality gain is limited.
